text:
Alex: Heads up — staged rollout for release/2026-03-18 was paused by the deployment monitor. Seeing ~18% p95 regression on short-seq (<=128) text gen requests after the kernel-selector refactor in merge #842. Investigating.
ops-bot: deployment monitor: rollout for release/2026-03-18 paused at 30% due to latency SLO breach (p95 > 120ms). Incident created: INC-2026-172.
Maya: ack. which changes in #842 could affect tiny-batch kernel choice? was that the heuristic tweak for sequence-length threshold? @Alex
Sam K: quick bisect started. running locally with the same perf harness against a small model replica to reproduce. command:

```
git bisect start HEAD v1.14.2
git bisect run tests/perf/run_latency_harness.sh --seq 128 --batch 8
```
Jun: dashboard snapshot: https://dash.internal/redwood/perf/seq<=128?p=release/2026-03-18 — KV miss rate jumped ~12pp at the same time latency rose. KV miss TTL changes were in the same PR? unsure.
Li: profiler traces show a switch from kernel "fused-attn-v2" to "attn-slow-path" for many tiny batches after the selector change. Sample lines:

```
[2026-03-18T10:13:02Z] kernel_choice: fused-attn-v2 -> attn-slow-path (seq=64, batch=4) cost_est 12.4 -> 18.9
[2026-03-18T10:13:02Z] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.27 -> 0.39 for route=hosted-eu-1
```
Sam K: bisect currently narrowed to commits between c3f9b2 and d4a8f0. Preliminary: toggling the new selector heuristic back to old returns latency to expected range locally.
Maya: can we reproduce the CI perf failure? ci-bot, paste job output for perf/regression/seq-128
ci-bot: perf/regression/seq-128 #1245 FAILED
stdout excerpt:
```
p95 baseline: 98.3ms
p95 current: 116.4ms (+18.3%)
kv miss rate: baseline 0.18 current 0.33
```
Jun: looks correlated — KV miss increase explains extra token decode time due to more KV loads and fallback to slow kernel. Might be a regression in the kernel ranking cost model (new penalty for small KV hits).
Alex: plan proposals:
- emergency rollback of the selector logic in runtime to prior commit (fast, but touches hot path)
- deploy a temporary config override to force selector=legacy for short sequence workloads (safer, no code revert)
- continue bisect and ship a targeted fix to cost model and KV heuristics
Which one can we do within the 2 hour SLA window?
Li: I can push a config override to the control plane that sets KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy for route patterns matching seq<=128. low risk and reversible.
Sam K: if we do override, I'll run a smoke pass across dedicated pools and confirm p95. Patch outline I prepared:

```
PATCH: control-plane: rollout-config override for kernel_selector
- add selector_override map keyed by workload signature
- fallback to global selector when not matched
```
Maya: +1 for config override. avoids touching runtime code mid-day. also helps confirm root cause without full revert.
ops-bot: SLO gating summary: p95 breach continues on 30% of nodes. automatic rollback to previous release is disabled for this catalog due to the alpha-fallback flag. Manual action required.
Jun: small test I ran toggling selector back shows kv miss drop ~10pp and p95 returns under 100ms in 3/3 runs. good signal.
Alex: OK execute steps:
1) Li deploys selector override to control plane now. 2) Sam runs smoke perf tests across staging->dedicated pools. 3) If green, resume staged rollout at 10% and monitor 5min windows. 4) Open PR to adjust cost model and KV TTL heuristics (owners: Sam, Jun).
Li: pushing override config now.
Sam K: running smoke.sh against staging... ETA 8m
Maya: added to incident INC-2026-172: mitigation=selector-override, owners=Li/Sam/Jun, comms=oncall@redwood.io
ci-bot: perf/regression/seq-128 #1246 (after override) RUNNING
Sam K: smoke results: p95 median=95.6ms over 5 runs, kv miss drop confirmed. rolling resume plan looks safe.
Alex: great. leave rollout paused until we see two consecutive 5-minute windows green on the SLO dashboard. after that we resume ramp slowly and keep selector_override in place until PR lands.
Maya: note for postmortem: add a test in CI that exercises kernel-selector with varied small-batch distributions and KV miss synthetic injection.
Jun: I'll start the fix branch for cost model adjustments and add unit tests for kernel penalty logic.
Alex: thanks team. keep updates in this thread. once PR is merged we'll remove selector_override and validate.
ops-bot: incident update: mitigation applied (selector_override), p95 moved to target range on 3/3 test nodes. Monitoring for 30 minutes.
